summary: This is a requirements file listing the Python packages needed to run a FastAPI web application with a production-grade server setup. FastAPI is the web framework, while Gunicorn and Uvicorn are different application servers that run the code—Gunicorn is a traditional option and Uvicorn is the modern async-compatible choice.

explanations.3: The [standard] part means 'install Uvicorn with all its optional dependencies included' rather than just the bare minimum, giving you extra features out of the box.
